text: dsh-icon-theme 是面向 DSH Web 的图标自定义插件。它发现设置页和侧边栏已注册的目标，为目标匹配原图标、预设图标或安全回退图标，并在设置界面提供搜索、筛选、图标选择和重置操作。用户可以为各目标保存覆盖图标，并选择是否优先保留原图标。适合希望统一 DSH 设置与侧边栏图标的用户；需要 DSH Web 的设置表单和界面插槽服务。

dsh-icon-theme customizes icons in DSH Web settings and sidebar. It discovers registered targets, matches original, preset, or fallback glyphs, and provides an Icons page to search targets, choose overrides, set original-icon policy, and reset choices. It uses DSH settings forms and UI slots.
想给 DSH 设置页面里的各个分类换成更容易辨认的图标。

DSH 新增的设置分类没有合适图标时，能自动补上吗？
我想让原有图标保持不变，只覆盖我指定的几项。

dsh-icon-theme 的功能「设置页图标管理」：在插件提供的 Icons 设置页查看已发现的设置目标。用户可搜索、筛选目标，打开图标选择器替换图标，也可以单独或全部重置为自动解析。
dsh-icon-theme 的功能「自动匹配图标」：插件根据用户覆盖、捆绑图标、可信原图、精确预设和 ID 推断的顺序解析图标；无法识别时使用现有图标或设置齿轮回退。
dsh-icon-theme 的功能「发现设置与侧栏目标」：监听 DSH 的设置分区和侧栏页脚操作插槽，读取注册项 ID 和显示标签，按插槽顺序整理可管理的图标目标。
dsh-icon-theme 的功能「保留或替换原图标」：用户可选择优先保留原图标，或替换通用图标；插件在卸载或适配器清理时恢复其管理过的页面元素。
dsh-icon-theme 的功能「设置图标覆盖保存」：选中图标后将目标键与图标 ID 写入 DSH 的 Host 设置表单，失败时显示错误并从表单刷新当前状态。
dsh-icon-theme 仅声明 DSH Web 客户端注入，且依赖 DSH 配置表单和插槽接口；清单将兼容版本限制为 0.2.1-rc.5 或 0.2.2-alpha.3。

dsh-icon-theme README · dsh-icon-theme：English | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

Automatic, coherent, and user-customizable icons for DeepSeek Harness Settings and sidebar actions.

_Screenshots use the Chinese locale; the plugin ships equivalent English labels._

dsh-icon-theme README · Why this plugin：`dsh-icon-theme` discovers the live slot ledger, preserves trustworthy original icons, fills recognizable gaps with a small Fluent-style pack, and lets the user override every supported target. Version 0.3 uses DSH's official configuration forms and, where available, the official Settings icon slot.

dsh-icon-theme README · Why this plugin：- Discovers live winning `settings.section` and `sidebar.footer.action` contributions generically. Audited per-plugin records are used only when a sidebar is partially rendered and cannot be correlated by order.
- Stores choices by stable key, such as `settings.section:market`, never by translated labels or DOM position.
- Ships 50 curated Fluent UI 16 Regular glyphs, 70 official DSH UI glyphs, and the audited monochrome dsh-market glyph (121 total).
- Uses no icon CDN, webfont, Iconify API, GitHub request, or package scanning at runtime.
- Restores every host SVG and owned DOM marker on unload or hot reload.
- Reports non-rendered contributions and non-icon cards instead of pretending they were changed.
- Falls back to the Settings gear when a target has neither a trustworthy match nor an original icon.

dsh-icon-theme README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-icon-theme
```

Restart `dsh web`, then open **Settings → Icons**.

To install from a source checkout instead:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/yzke/dsh-icon-theme.git
cd dsh-icon-theme
npm ci
npm run build

Requires Node.js **24.9+**. The `engines.dsh` and DSH peer range is deliberately limited to the tested versions: **`0.2.1-rc.5 || 0.2.2-alpha.3`**. Other prereleases are not implicitly supported. For DSH 0.1, keep `dsh-icon-theme@0.2.3`.

dsh-icon-theme README · Install：| DSH version | Settings icons | Configuration |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `0.2.1-rc.5` (npm latest at release) | Reversible DOM adapter | Official `configForms` |
| `0.2.2-alpha.3` (preview) | Official `settings.section.icon` slot | Official `configForms` |

dsh-icon-theme README · Install：**Desktop:** install through the desktop application's Plugin Manager, or its own bundled `dsh` command while the application is fully quit. Desktop owns the reserved `desktop` profile; the npm CLI cannot manage that profile. The shared Web client and Host APIs are supported by this package, but native Windows/macOS Desktop installers have not been end-to-end qualified. See [official Desktop ownership](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/dsh-v0.2.2-alpha.3/apps/desktop/README.md#installation-ownership).

dsh-icon-theme README · Uninstall：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-icon-theme
```

Restart `dsh web`. The plugin restores every host SVG and removes all owned DOM markers and styles on unload.

dsh-icon-theme README · Use：The page lists every discovered target, its stable key, its compatibility state, and the source of the current icon. Search by feature name, ID, or icon; filter Settings/sidebar/unrecognized/customized entries; choose a glyph; or restore one/all targets to automatic behavior.

Resolution is deterministic:

dsh-icon-theme README · Use：1. User override.
2. Audited, bundled plugin glyph.
3. Trustworthy DSH/plugin original.
4. Exact stable-ID preset.
5. Unambiguous stable-ID inference.
6. Existing host fallback, or Settings gear when no original exists.

Localized labels are display and search text only. They never decide a persisted mapping.

dsh-icon-theme README · Sidebar behavior：| State | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Rendered icon action | Changeable; the original is preserved by default. |
| Registered but not rendered | Listed as “can preset”; the override applies when it appears. |
| Non-icon card | Reported but deliberately left unchanged. |
| Unknown or changed DOM | Left untouched unless a unique audited compatibility record exists. |

dsh-icon-theme README · Sidebar behavior：The sidebar footer and rc.5 Settings adapters remain narrow and reversible. Alpha.3 Settings uses official icon contributions, preserves other providers, and releases its overrides on unload. New surfaces such as `sidebar.panellist` are outside this plugin's scope. See [the design note](docs/design.md).

dsh-icon-theme README · Sidebar behavior：When `dsh-better-sidebar` is installed, its own Settings row icon is treated as a trusted original and preserved by default. It is replaced only when the user chooses `replace-generic` (or a manual override).

dsh-icon-theme README · Ecosystem checks：Compatibility fixtures are pinned to real open-source registration excerpts, including `dsh-full-remote`, `dsh-context`, `dsh-openpencil`, `dsh-approve-for-me`, and `dsh-composer-polish`. They prove that an unknown Settings section is discovered generically, while contributions to unrelated surfaces are not misidentified. Details and pinned commits are in [ecosystem compatibility](docs/ecosystem-compatibility.md). The sidebar fallback fingerprints are also pinned to upstream revisions and may need periodic updates if those plugins change their DOM.

dsh-icon-theme README · Development and release gate：```bash
npm ci
npm run qa
npm run test:web
npm pack --dry-run

For the optional live-host smoke test:

```bash
DSH_E2E_URL='http://127.0.0.1:3184/?token=TEST_PROFILE_TOKEN' npm run test:web -- -t @real-dsh
```

The full testing contract is documented in [TESTING.md](TESTING.md). Icon sources and licenses are recorded in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

dsh-icon-theme README · Privacy and security：Detection reads only DSH slot metadata and the two rendered UI surfaces. The plugin does not inspect user files or other plugins' bundles. Preferences use DSH's shared `configForms` service for the `dsh-icon-theme` Host entry. DSH owns authentication, revision checks, persistence, and reconnection for both Web and Desktop; the plugin has no private HTTP endpoint or browser-local preference copy.
